title: Numbers
introduction: Numbers traces Israel in the wilderness from Sinai toward the plains of Moab through a sequence of census, cultic law, leadership crises, journeys, and land preparation. These nine studies follow literary divisions; they do not claim nine independently dated historical events. Archaeology, historical reconstruction, and later interpretation are distinguished from biblical testimony.
